notes.notes: [h1]Update 0.10.0[/h1][p] [/p][h2]Changes :[/h2][olist][*][p]The camera can now be freely moved around by dragging the background with the mouse / using the "camera mode" with the controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Middle mouse button can now recenter the camera around the puzzle pieces. [/p][/*][*][p]New floating text tutorials to explain these new controls[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels move the camera to new areas with darker / lighter moods that correspond better to their theme.[/p][/*][*][p]The mining theme's rocks' lights now gradually pulse from dark to bright[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual changes to the level select screen[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2][olist][*][p]Level 5 sometimes started with a missing piece[/p][/*][*][p]The player could clip through solid platforms when a piece was picked up and dropped very quickly[/p][/*][*][p]The player could enter the "ghost piece" overlay[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain changes could thread infinitely[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing ESC in certain menus would play the SFX twice[/p][/*][*][p]The mouse cursor was slightly offset[/p][/*][/olist][p] [/p][h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2][olist][*][p]The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall [/p][/*][*][p]Some player animations may play strangely when running into a wall[/p][/*][*][p]Puzzle pieces edge lights do not connect properly between them[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.notes: [h1]Update 0.9.3[/h1][p] [/p][h2]Changes :[/h2][olist][*][p]Level 13 now has more space to prevent the player from accidentally entering the portal when exiting the dirt[/p][/*][*][p]A feedback menu (accessible anywhere using F12) was added. notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Visuals and QOL
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.9.0[/h1]

[h2]Changes :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] You now need to press "up" to enter a door. This should prevent finishing a level by accident
[*] The Neon Polygons splash screen was remade in-engine
[*] Dimensional rifts are now distorted when in proximity of the player
[*] A visual feedback was added when hovering checkboxes
[*] Improved performances in levels containing a lot of puzzle pieces
[*] Puzzle pieces now change their appearance when connecting with another piece to match their layout
[/olist]

[h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added missing tile in one of the levels
[*] Fixed a visual glitch with the pause button when dragging over it
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes enter a door automatically when close to it and dropping the piece
[*] Fixed a bug where flat sides would sometimes not connect properly
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed an impossible type of connection to happen
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would move weirdly in angled pieces
[*] Removed the initial click sound that played in levels where puzzle pieces start connected
[/olist]

[h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall
[*] Glowing dirt in the miner theme sometimes has its light flicker
[*] shadows inside the miner's theme do not always appear
[/olist]

notes.title: Piece by Piece Demo is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The puzzle box is ready to be opened, we're very excited to announce that [b]the newest demo for Piece by Piece is live![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429540/?snr=1_5_9__205

Our team has been working hard on the full release of Piece by Piece which will feature 100 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty and new mechanics/themes to explore! In the meantime, we'd like to showcase 13 of our beginner/intermediate levels in our NextFest demo! 

Whether you're new to puzzle games or a puzzle master, we invite you to check out our[i] literal puzzle platformer[/i] and see what you think. If you'd like to support our efforts, please wishlist the game on Steam so you'll be notified of when we launch in May/June of this year! 

Thank you for your support and we look forward to your feedback on the demo! 

-Neon Polygons

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Minor changes and bugfixes

[h1]Update 0.3.0[/h1]

[h2]Changes :[/h2]

[*] New custom cursor
[*] Added menu sound effects
[*] Changed the "Back" button for an arrow
[*] Updated the "Reset speedrun timer" progress bar to look cleaner
[*] Updated the dust texture

[h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2]

[*] Fixed a bug where the back button didn't work in the Credits menu
[*] Fixed settings panel size to work with all languages
[/olist]

[h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall.
[*] Glowing dirt in the miner theme sometimes has its light flicker.
[*] The player will sometimes enter a door if next to it when the piece snaps in place.
[*] Player movement can be a bit jittery when inside a tilted piece.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Minor BugFixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.2.0[/h1]

[h2]Fixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] You can no longer zoom / unzoom during screen transitions
[*] You can no longer zoom / unzoom in the settings menu
[*] You can no longer drag pieces outside of the viewport
[*] Aligning two flat sides perfectly no longer connects them if they are not connected through other pieces
[*] The player will no longer disappear if a piece is picked up when they are standing exactly in the middle of the two pieces.
[*] Pieces will now prioritise snapping to the biggest connection group, instead of moving the already placed pieces towards it.
[*] Pieces now correctly lose their focus when the game is paused.
[/olist]

[h2]Known, Unfixed Bugs :[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The player's speed can increase temporarily if they try to dig while in between a dirt block and a wall.
[*] Glowing dirt in the miner theme sometimes has its light flicker.
[/olist]
